title: 交替合并字符串
summary: 从 word1 开始交替取两个字符串的字符，一侧用尽后追加另一侧剩余字符。
insight: 用同一下标依次追加两串存在的第 i 个字符，自然实现交替和尾部补齐。
pitfalls: 保持各自字符相对顺序

solutions.title: 单下标交织
solutions.idea: 逐位置分别检查两串是否还有字符。
steps: i<word1.length 则追加 word1[i]，i<word2.length 则追加 word2[i]

code.java: class Solution { public String mergeAlternately(String word1,String word2){StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0;i<Math.max(word1.length(),word2.length());i++){if(i<word1.length())answer.append(word1.charAt(i));if(i<word2.length())answer.append(word2.charAt(i));}return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun mergeAlternately(word1:String,word2:String):String{val answer=StringBuilder();for(i in 0 until maxOf(word1.length,word2.length)){if(i<word1.length)answer.append(word1[i]);if(i<word2.length)answer.append(word2[i])};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string mergeAlternately(string word1,string word2){string answer;for(int i=0;i<(int)max(word1.size(),word2.size());++i){if(i<(int)word1.size())answer+=word1[i];if(i<(int)word2.size())answer+=word2[i];}return answer;} };
